mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_training_policy WHERE owner_dept_id=#{ownerDeptId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_training_policy_revision SET published_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),published_by_user_id=#{user},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND published_at IS NULL

UPDATE vi_training_policy SET active_revision_id=#{activeRevisionId},draft_revision_id=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND draft_revision_id=#{activeRevisionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_training_progress WHERE run_id=#{run} ORDER BY training_id
SELECT * FROM vi_training_progress WHERE run_id=#{run} AND training_id=#{training} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_training_progress SET verified_duration_millis=#{verifiedDurationMillis},verified_duration_seconds=#{verifiedDurationSeconds}, verified_segments=#{verifiedSegments},active_playback_id=#{activePlaybackId}, status=#{status},last_position_seconds=#{lastPositionSeconds},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_training_playback WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_training_playback SET last_reported_at=#{lastReportedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, last_position_millis=#{lastPositionMillis},last_playing=#{lastPlaying},last_sequence=#{lastSequence}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_training_attempt WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_training_attempt WHERE application_id=#{application} AND course_key=#{key} AND status='OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_training_attempt WHERE run_id=#{run} AND training_id=#{training} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_training_attempt SET status=#{status},answer_snapshot=#{answerSnapshot},grading_snapshot_cipher=#{gradingSnapshotCipher}, submission_mac=#{submissionMac},score=#{score}, submitted_at=#{submittedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE vi_training_run SET status='PASSED',provider_verification_id=#{proof},completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE' AND provider_verification_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,application_id,material_revision,material_hash,provider,task_type,status,verified_at FROM vi_provider_verification WHERE id=#{id} AND provider='INTERNAL_TRAINING' AND task_type='TRAINING' AND status='PASSED' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT progress.training_id,progress.verified_duration_millis,progress.status, MAX(attempt.score) passed_score FROM vi_training_progress progress LEFT JOIN vi_training_attempt attempt ON attempt.run_id=progress.run_id AND attempt.training_id=progress.training_id AND attempt.application_id=progress.application_id AND attempt.material_revision=progress.material_revision AND attempt.material_hash=progress.material_hash AND attempt.status='PASSED' AND attempt.grading_snapshot_cipher IS NOT NULL AND attempt.submission_mac IS NOT NULL AND attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL JOIN vi_training_run current_run ON current_run.id=progress.run_id AND current_run.application_id=progress.application_id AND current_run.material_revision=progress.material_revision AND current_run.material_hash=progress.material_hash WHERE progress.run_id=#{run} GROUP BY progress.training_id,progress.verified_duration_millis,progress.status

SELECT progress.training_id,progress.verified_duration_millis,progress.status, MAX(attempt.score) passed_score FROM vi_training_progress progress LEFT JOIN vi_training_attempt attempt ON attempt.run_id=progress.run_id AND attempt.training_id=progress.training_id AND attempt.application_id=progress.application_id AND attempt.material_revision=progress.material_revision AND attempt.material_hash=progress.material_hash AND attempt.status='PASSED' AND attempt.grading_snapshot_cipher IS NOT NULL AND attempt.submission_mac IS NOT NULL AND attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND attempt.submitted_at<=#{asOf,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} JOIN vi_training_run current_run ON current_run.id=progress.run_id AND current_run.application_id=progress.application_id AND current_run.material_revision=progress.material_revision AND current_run.material_hash=progress.material_hash WHERE progress.run_id=#{run} AND progress.updated_at<=#{asOf,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} GROUP BY progress.training_id,progress.verified_duration_millis,progress.status

SELECT app.id application_id,run.id run_id,profile.training_context_revision company_revision, app.material_revision,HEX(app.material_hash) material_hex FROM vi_driver_profile profile JOIN vi_account account ON account.id=profile.account_id JOIN sys_dept company ON company.dept_id=profile.owner_dept_id AND company.status='0' AND company.del_flag='0' JOIN vi_driver_application app ON app.driver_id=profile.id JOIN vi_training_plan_snapshot plan ON plan.application_id=app.id AND plan.owner_dept_id=profile.owner_dept_id AND plan.company_revision=profile.training_context_revision JOIN vi_training_run run ON run.plan_snapshot_id=plan.id AND run.application_id=app.id AND run.material_revision=app.material_revision AND run.material_hash=app.material_hash JOIN JSON_TABLE(plan.course_snapshot,'$[*]' COLUMNS(media_file_id BIGINT PATH '$.mediaFileId')) selected ON selected.media_file_id=#{file} WHERE profile.account_id=#{account} AND account.phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND account.phone_cipher IS NOT NULL AND app.id=( SELECT current.id FROM vi_driver_application current WHERE current.driver_id=profile.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN current.active_driver IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,current.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1
